semiconductor_relevance: Medium — AICELLO-HARKE GmbH provides specialized plastic products and materials for cleanroom applications, which are crucial for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: AICELLO-HARKE GmbH develops and manufactures high-quality plastic products, including advanced packaging and assembly materials tailored for semiconductor cleanroom applications. Their product offerings include plastic films designed for insulation and anti-corrosion, supporting contamination control in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Advanced packaging and assembly materials for cleanroom applications
Plastic films for insulation and anti-corrosion
